entities.name: Luciano José Cabral Duarte
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luciano José Cabral Duarte was a Brazilian prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as auxiliary bishop of Aracajú from 1966 till 1971, when he became archbishop of Aracajú. He resigned in 1998 and was succeeded by José Palmeira Lessa. He was professor of philosophy and one of the founders at the Federal University of Sergipe.
